payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged). Fixed the stale fixture at its SOURCE: packages/protocol/src/fixtures/product-test-schema.ts (the .bin + codegen goldens are generated from it). Updated the call types to mirror frick_server::calls::schema field-for-field (CallRoom now carries kind + all 9 fields; added CallInvite/CallParticipant + the 7 events + WebRTCSignal), regenerated the wire + Swift/Kotlin/TS codegen goldens + builder_golden, kept the opaque schema hash to minimize blast radius, and DROPPED the runtime strip-and-splice (calls.rs now uses the canonical fixture; calls.test.ts uses productTestSchema directly). Every gate green: cargo test --workspace (975), clippy, fmt, pnpm verify:generated, typecheck, vitest. Built by a subagent under a strict do-not-commit-red guard.
